name: Walker S2
summary: The third industrial Walker, and the first humanoid built around a robot swapping its own batteries: a dual-battery pack lets it keep one cell live while its arms pull the depleted one and slot in a charged replacement at a station, in about three minutes. That removes the recharge stop that caps a shift, which is why UBTECH pitches S2 for continuous 24/7 factory and logistics duty.
notable: First humanoid with an autonomous hot-swap battery system
